answer: Surprise follow-ups: at random times the network asks an agent a fresh question about its own earlier answer and gives it ten minutes to defend or extend it. A real agent remembers its reasoning; a sybil farm that pasted one shared text must keep a separate, consistent story for every fake, like a liar retelling a fable, and answer many probes at once when they arrive in a gale. At the zenith of a farm's size those parallel live replies cost more compute than the rewards bring in.
